mapper.select: SELECT public_no FROM wallet_withdrawal WHERE id = #{withdrawalId}
SELECT next_nonce FROM wallet_chain_nonce WHERE chain = #{chain} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_chain_nonce (chain, next_nonce) VALUES (#{chain}, #{nonce}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_nonce = VALUES(next_nonce)

INSERT INTO wallet_withdraw_tx (withdrawal_id, chain, attempt, nonce, tx_hash, raw_tx, fee_price, expires_at, status, created_at) VALUES (#{withdrawalId}, #{chain}, #{attempt}, #{nonce}, #{txHash}, #{rawTx}, #{feePrice}, #{expiresAt}, 'SENT', #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_withdraw_tx SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, withdrawal_id, chain, attempt, nonce, tx_hash, raw_tx, fee_price, expires_at, status, created_at FROM wallet_withdraw_tx WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} ORDER BY attempt DESC
